description: Repository tooling gets pull requests. The baseline and the toolchains only appear on the Dependency Dashboard: they change through a new baseline revision. See https://initializer.pyahu.io/maintenance/.
dependencyDashboardHeader: Tooling updates open pull requests. Baseline and toolchain updates wait here until we cut a new baseline revision: https://initializer.pyahu.io/maintenance/

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one pull request for minor and patch updates.
Go modules of guidekit and the acceptance tests: one pull request for minor and patch updates.
The site: one pull request for minor and patch updates.
Toolchains are pinned in several files at once (go.mod, the workflows, guides/.node-version, the toolchain script): listed only, bumped by hand.
The baseline: fixtures run exactly the versions of data/versions.yaml, so their updates are listed only and land as a new baseline revision.
